scope: Predictive representations of curated-release counts in provider-annotated mouse CA1 and DG; not lossless recording dynamics or anatomical/mechanistic validation.
metric: Causal joint predictive log likelihood divided by actual scored nominal curated-release unit-bins; nats/nominal curated-release unit-bin
estimand: Equal-mouse mean of (family LL minus strongest development-selected eligible baseline LL) in CA1 minus the corresponding gain in DG. Three two-sided family-specific zero contrasts, Holm correction within group.
hypotheses: Discrete baseline-adjusted CA1/DG difference is nonzero
Continuous baseline-adjusted CA1/DG difference is nonzero
Hybrid baseline-adjusted CA1/DG difference is nonzero

allocation.algorithm: Sort mice by SHA256 of P12-CURATED-EXPLORATORY-V1|animal|mouse_id. First 13 development, remaining 13 final. No reallocation.

trials.partition: Within each condition order by SHA256 of mission|trial|session_id|row_index. First45 train for development/calibration for final; remaining30 validation for development/locked_evaluation for final. Partition all600 before exclusions; never replenish exclusions.
trials.window: First exactly2 seconds, half-open [start,start+2);20 bins of0.1 seconds in master elapsed clock. Reject entire trial if actual duration<2 or any chosen unit probe lacks anchor-bracketed support/has overlapping known invalid interval. No tolerance extends exposure beyond stop.
trials.coverage: After matched masks require at least24 train/calibration and16 validation/evaluation trials for each of8 conditions. Admission cannot depend on final spike counts. Final trial duration/support QC uses metadata only.
trials.reset: All count history and hidden state reset to zero/prior at every trial; first bin scored unconditionally. Current/future counts forbidden as covariates.
trials.movies: Not a secondary neural analysis in this study. Previous failed movie audits remain disclosed. No frames treated as trials.

unit_qc.anatomy: CA1 or DG/DG-mo/DG-po/DG-sg identity join; finite CCF coordinates required. No CA3 pooled into primary.
unit_qc.sampling_rate: Quarantine probe846401834 and every nonfinite/nonpositive exported rate; no inferred substitution.
unit_qc.training_only: Development train or final calibration only; no whole-session firing_rate/presence_ratio/ISI/amplitude/waveform quality metrics.
unit_qc.ISI_policy: Only adjacent spikes inside the same permitted trial; zero within-trial pairs gives0 violations but is explicitly reported. Nonfinite, negative, duplicate or unordered permitted spike timestamps fail unit QC.
unit_qc.cap_rule: Retain all eligible identities in audit; choose up to32 by SHA256(mission|unit|unit_id), not outcome rank. Apply identical fixed selection algorithm in both regions.
unit_qc.count_qc: Finite nonnegative integer counts, no clipping/imputation, known masks identical between CA1 and DG, exact20bins, sum counts equals permitted half-open spikes, no inferred physiological eligibility from stored identity counts.

access.M2: Development training and final calibration neural values only. Source shape/dtype/link/chunk metadata and unit IDs/index structure permitted. Opaque transport may include mixed content; zero transport is not claimed.
access.holdout: No final evaluation spike timestamps/counts/quality/behavioral outcomes decoded before M6. Whole-session get_spike_times or read-all-then-filter is not authorized. Time-index discovery by probing arbitrary final timestamps is not authorized.
access.required_reader_proof: A metadata-identifiable temporal slice or separate calibration-only derivative must establish permitted trial membership before any neural-value read. If unavailable, stop at leakage/access gate with eligibility NOT_ASSESSED, not biological insufficiency.
access.M3_M5: Only development train/validation. Final calibration retained behind independent access role until frozen M6 fit policy; M2 unit QC only.
access.M6: One frozen held-out-animal evaluation after all prior gates/nulls pass; no new selections or repeat validation.

models.baseline_features: Intercept;5 lagged log1p own counts;5 lagged log1p population counts (exclude current bin);7 condition indicators and19 within-trial bin indicators; known trial index/599 and its square. History=own only, population=all lagged units only, event=condition/bin only, drift=order/order squared only, combined=own+population+condition/bin+order/order squared. Train-only scaling, intercept unpenalized.
models.observation: Full Poisson count PMF including log-factorial in every model. HMM exact forward; hybrid exact forward with observed causal history, not integrated unobserved PLDS/SLDS; recurrence deterministic causal observed-history tanh.
models.continuous: Recurrent state dimension1/2/4, tanh driven by prior log1p population counts and known condition/bin/order context; Poisson output, zero initial state.
models.hybrid: K-state observed own-history Poisson AR,5lags, exact forward, free normalized state transition and initial probabilities; shared stimulus/time/order offset fitted on training only and frozen for candidate comparison.
models.discrete: K-state history-free Poisson emission, same training-fitted stimulus/time/order offset as hybrid. No full-sequence smoothing for predictive evaluation.
models.budget: All bounded configurations and all3seeds; L-BFGS-B max500iterations/max20000objective calls per fit, coefficient bounds[-8,8], ftol1e-5/gtol1e-5; no extra restarts/favorable seed pruning. Preserve optimizer messages, gradient norms, time, boundary hits and all failures.
models.convergence: Require finite objective/score, optimizer success, maximum projected gradient<=0.001. Every seed and every admitted development mouse/region must pass for a configuration to be eligible. Any family without eligible configuration stops M4 INCONCLUSIVE.
models.numerics: Before fitting: exact small-state enumeration vs forward abs error<=1e-10; Poisson analytic<=1e-12; relative finite-difference gradient error<=1e-5; future-count perturbation leaves earlier causal score unchanged<=1e-12; batch partition/order invariance<=1e-10. Synthetic fixtures test code only, never scientific observations.

selection.seed_score: Mean unpenalized validation LL across all3seeds, no selected favorable seed; every seed retained. Final policy refits all3seeds on calibration and averages their scores under the same definition, not mislabeled as mixture likelihood.
selection.family: One configuration per family shared across CA1/DG: rank pooled equal-mouse mean region-average LL; threshold best mean minus sample SE of its mouse scores. Within threshold choose least mean parameter count, then smallest dimension/state then largest ridge. Seed failures make configuration ineligible, never silently exclude a mouse.
selection.baseline: Strongest eligible baseline configuration by equal-mouse mean development LL separately per region; deterministic ties lower parameter count then largest ridge. Freeze before final calibration model fitting; do not choose per final mouse.
selection.complexity: Report exact parameter counts, regularization, training bins per parameter, elapsed cost, bound hits, eligible and failed configuration denominators. Distinguish one-SE selection from raw maxima.

statistics.unit: Mouse only; no neuron/trial/session pseudoreplication. One session per inventoried mouse; probes contribute within mouse.
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 whole-mouse paired resamples, seed20261101; percentile95%CI, family differences and individual-mouse effects retained.
statistics.sign_flip: Exact all2^N mouse-wise sign assignments for N<=20;two-sided inclusive absolute-mean comparison; Holm3primary family pvalues per development/final group.
statistics.exploratory: Development statistics exploratory after model selection; final effects single-release held-out-animal validation, not independent lab replication.

sensitivities: Matched unit count per mouse=min(CA1,DG,32), identities hash-ranked from training/calibration eligible set

Calibration-rate matching: sort eligible units by train/calibration rate; deterministic nearest-rate greedy pairs within absolute log-rate distance<=log(2); minimum5pairs otherwise sensitivity unavailable and M5 incomplete
Provider-channel vertical boundary proxy exclusions<=20um and<=40um; units with undefined proxy excluded in sensitivity; minimum5perregion and8paired mice needed; not histology CI
Probe dependence: report all probe composition, single-probe-region strata and leave-one-probe-out paired contrast when>=5units/region remain; do not infer independent probe subjects
Dropout/continuity sensitivity: preregistered deterministic artificial10%whole-trial drop at hash ranks, not proof of native continuity; score each sensitivity separately
Leave-one-mouse-out estimates; session equals mouse in this inventory, no independent session denominator

nulls.seeds: 20261201+i for i0..198; all retained; p=(1+extreme)/(200); Holm across3families within each null suite
nulls.count_rate_preserving: Per unit/trial random bin permutation, exact trial spike count preserved; refit selected model/baseline configurations on transformed training; evaluate transformed validation, no grid reselection
nulls.temporal_shift: Independent nonzero circular bin shifts1..19 per unit/trial; same rules, exact counts retained
nulls.stimulus_timing: Permute trial condition labels within partition only while retaining counts/order; never exchange final/development or train/validation trials
nulls.order_drift: Permute known trial-order covariates within condition/partition only; keep stimulus/bin context; compare drift and combined baselines
nulls.policy: All required suites complete with eligible mice and valid numerics before final unlock; failures/incomplete suites stop. Final procedures frozen from development, calibration-only refits; no final-driven rescue.

stopping: Critical leakage/access/numerical failure =>INCONCLUSIVE/STOP; actual measured eligible mice<8in either group =>DATA_INSUFFICIENT/STOP. Unknown eligibility is NOT_ASSESSED, not DATA_INSUFFICIENT. No reshuffle/threshold relaxation. Prepare accurate saved-evidence closeout; M7 only if M1-M6 pass.
limitations: Nominal curated exposure; packet continuity unverified
Physical frame matching does not establish unique event identity
Within-release held-out animals, not independent laboratory or human replication
M7: Method paper, full tables/raw maxima/selected scores, mouse effects, allnulls/failures, supplement,A1-A10,hash-traceablefigures,PDFvisualQA,PowerShell data/fit and saved-results reproduction explicitly distinguished, claim audit; no NAP/CWP proof.
